DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 大人って、結構服にこだわるよね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: たしかに、そうかもしれない

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 私はあまり詳しくないけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ちょっと時間ができたし、買い物に行こうと思って

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あんまりファションに詳しくないから、後で先生に意見を聞きたくて

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: とりあえず、色々持ってくね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、今日はありがとう

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: また連絡するね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 約束の日だよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 約束……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 一緒に服を選んでくれるんだよね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 前に約束したでしょ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今から送る場所に来て

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: わ、分かった……！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日はありがとう、先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: プレゼントまでもらって……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 気にしないで

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 氷海に行くときは、絶対に防寒着で来てね！？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うん。これ、すごく気に入ったから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 毎日着るね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 次の作戦について話があるんだけど、時間ある？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 今日は手が離せなくて……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それなら仕方ないか

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: また連絡するね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生……風邪、大丈夫？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、暖かくしてたら良くなったよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: なら良かった

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日もありがとう、先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 服に組み合わせがあったなんて、知らなかった

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そうだ、今度から下着の代わりに水着を着ようかな

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: さっきジャケットの中でたくさん汗をかいたけど、水着だから濡れても気にならなかったの

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 機能美って言うんだっけ……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: えっと、うん……間違ってはないかな

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: さすが先生

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ファッションって奥深いね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: また今度、色々教えて

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、ここはパラダイスかもしれない

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: パラダイス？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うん……いい場所を見つけた

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生も来る？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 温泉でも見つけたとか？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ん……似てるかな……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 水風呂は諦めるよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: よかった！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: でも、どうして諦めたの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 冷水浴は気持ちよかったけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 毎回先生がお茶を淹れてくれるわけじゃないし……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: もし私が風邪を引いたら、先生が心配するから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いつもありがとう、先生

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 어른들은 옷에 꽤나 신경 쓰는 편이지?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 잠시 여유가 생긴 김에 쇼핑을 하려는데.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 나는 패션에 대해서 잘 모르니까 선생님과 함께 훈련을 해 보려고.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 저번에 옷 고르는 것을 도와주기로 했잖아.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 빙해에 갈 때는 수영복만 입지 말고 꼭 그 차림으로 가는 거야!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 다음 작전에 대해 특무부실에서 잠깐 이야기를 하고 싶은데 시간 괜찮아?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이 옷에 그런 뜻이 담겨 있었다니.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그러고 보니 속옷 대신에 수영복을 입는 것도 좋은 것 같아.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 재킷 안에 땀이 많이 났지만 수영복이라 젖어도 괜찮은 거 있지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 패션이란 여러 가지를 고려해야 하는 거구나.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 역시 냉수 욕조를 만드는 건 포기하기로 했어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 음… 물론 그 정도의 온도는 아무렇지도 않은 기분 좋은 수준이지만…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님이 항상 차를 끓여줄 수 있는 것도 아니고.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Are adults particular about their clothing?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I guess it depends.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: It's not really my priority...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I have free time. I wanted to use it to go shopping.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: But fashion is foreign to me. You're a teacher, so please train me in your ways.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I will come meet you after gathering supplies.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Thank you for the training today, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I will contact you soon.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The day has come, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What day?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You previously agreed to help me shop for clothes.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Today is the day you will make good on your promise.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm sending you the location now. Please come immediately.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You're so unintentionally assertive...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm very grateful for your assistance today. Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You fulfilled your original directive and purchased me a gift.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I was happy to do it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: PLEASE don't wear just a swimsuit if you're going to the Glacial Sea.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yes. I like this jacket.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I will wear it as often as possible.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Are you busy? Please meet me in the Special Operations Room to discuss our next mission.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: My schedule's a little packed right now.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I see. Understood.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I will contact you at a later time.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Are you feeling better, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I've warmed up now! Thank you!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I am relieved.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Thank you for your assistance today, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I was unaware of the implications of my outfit.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Replacing my swimsuit with underwear was an inspired idea.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The absorbent material of the swimsuit serves well to soak up any sweat from the jacket.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I believe there is a term for this. Functionality?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You could call it that!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You are very wise, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Fashion is a complicated and convoluted industry.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I look forward to learning more about it from you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I believe this is paradise, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Paradise?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Yes. It is very excellent.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Would you like to visit paradise?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Oh! I hope it's a hot spring!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Um... It is of the same genre...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I have decided my cold tub endeavors were unrealistic.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'm relieved to hear that.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You were pretty excited about the project though.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I will miss the relaxing temperature of the water...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: However, you will not always be available to brew tea.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I cannot catch a cold and worry Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Thank you for your care, Sensei.

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
พวกผู้ใหญ่ค่อนข้างให้ความสำคัญ
กับเสื้อผ้าใช่มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ก็ใช่นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูแต่งตัวแบบลวกๆ เอาน่ะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ตอนนี้พอมีเวลาว่าง ก็เลยว่าจะไป
ซื้อเสื้อผ้าสักหน่อย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แต่ฉันไม่ค่อยรู้เกี่ยวกับแฟชั่น ก็เลย
อยากจะฝึกฝนด้านแฟชั่นกับคุณครูดู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นฉันจะเอาของที่จำเป็นไปนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู วันนี้ขอบคุณที่มาอยู่ด้วยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แล้วฉันจะติดต่อไปใหม่

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู และแล้ววันนี้ก็มาถึง

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คราวก่อนคุณครูบอกว่าจะช่วยฉัน
เลือกเสื้อผ้าไม่ใช่เหรอ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: วันช่วยเลือกเสื้อผ้ามาถึงแล้วนี่ไง

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เดี๋ยวส่งโลเคชั่นให้ มาหาฉันหน่อยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: รอไม่ไหวแล้ว...!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้ขอบคุณมากเลยนะ คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ทั้งช่วยเลือกเสื้อผ้า ทั้งยังให้ของขวัญ
อีก...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่ต้องคิดมากหรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ตอนไปธารน้ำแข็งก็อย่าใส่แต่ชุด
ว่ายน้ำล่ะ ใส่ตัวอื่นที่ครูให้ไปด้วย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อื้ม เสื้อผ้าถูกใจฉันมากเลยละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้าเป็นไปได้ฉันจะใส่ทุกวันเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันอยากคุยเกี่ยวกับปฏิบัติการต่อไป
สักหน่อย พอมีเวลามั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
อืม... พอดีวันนี้ครูงานยุ่งนิดหน่อย
คิดว่าไม่น่าได้นะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นเหรอ? งั้นก็ช่วยไม่ได้

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไว้ฉันติดต่อไปใหม่แล้วกัน

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครู ร่างกายเป็นยังไงบ้าง?
ดีขึ้นบ้างรึยัง?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อื้ม ครูอยู่ในที่อุ่นๆ ก็เลยดีขึ้นมากแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: โล่งอกไปที

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: วันนี้คุณครูก็ช่วยฉันไว้ได้เยอะเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เสื้อผ้าชุดนี้มีความหมายแบบนั้นอยู่
เหรอเนี่ย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
จะว่าไป ฉันว่าการใส่ชุดว่ายน้ำ
แทนชุดชั้นในก็น่าจะดีนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เวลาใส่แจ็กเกตแล้วเหงื่อชอบออก
แต่ถ้าข้างในเป็นชุดว่ายน้ำก็ไม่ต้องห่วง
เรื่องที่จะเปียก

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แบบนี้มันเรียกว่าอะไรนะ?
ความสวยงามที่มีประโยชน์ใช้สอย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: สมแล้วที่เป็นคุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เรื่องแฟชั่นนี่ต้องคำนึงถึงหลายๆ
อย่างสินะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ต่อไปก็มาสอนฉันอีกนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู ที่นี่อาจจะเป็นสวรรค์เลยก็ได้

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: สวรรค์เหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อื้ม... ฉันไปเจอที่ดีๆ มาน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครูก็มาด้วยมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: มีออนเซ็นหรืออะไรทำนองนั้นเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อืม... ก็คล้ายๆ กันนะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันตัดสินใจล้มเลิกเรื่องการทำ
อ่างอาบน้ำเย็นแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: คิดดีแล้วละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
จะว่าไป เอมิคิดจะเอาจริงเอาจัง
ขนาดนั้นเลยนะเนี่ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อืม... แน่นอนว่าอุณหภูมิประมาณนั้น
มันทำให้ฉันอารมณ์ดีมาก...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่ก็ใช่ว่าคุณครูจะชงชาให้ฉันได้ตลอด

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
และถ้าฉันเป็นหวัดขึ้นมา คุณครูก็คง
จะเป็นห่วง

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ขอบคุณที่ใส่ใจกันตลอดเลยนะคุณครู

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 大人對穿著都挺講究的吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 算是吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我都穿的很隨興……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 現在正好有空，我想趁這個機會去買點東西

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 但我不太瞭解時尚，所以想和老師一起訓練

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我會把需要的東西帶去

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，今天謝謝你陪我

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我會再聯絡你

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，那天到了

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 哪天？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 上次不是說好要幫我挑衣服嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天就是那個日子

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 快到我傳給你的地點來

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 好強的魄力……！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天真的很謝謝你，老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不但幫我挑衣服還送我禮物……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 不用客氣

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 去冰海的時候不能只穿泳裝，那件衣服也一定要穿著哦！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嗯，我真的很喜歡這件衣服

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我會盡可能每天都穿的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我想在特異現象搜查部跟你討論下一次的作戰，你有空嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 嗯……今天很忙，可能有點困難……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 是嗎？那就沒辦法了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我會再聯絡你

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，身體狀況有好一點嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 嗯，我穿暖一點之後就好多了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那就好

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天也謝謝你，老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 沒想到這件衣服還有那種含義

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 看來用泳裝代替內衣好像也不錯

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 就算夾克裡出了很多汗，反正是泳裝，濕了也沒關係

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 該怎麼形容？機能美？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 啊，嗯……你說的對

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不愧是老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 原來時尚要考慮這麼多因素啊

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 之後請再多教我一些

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，這裡可能是個樂園

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 樂園？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嗯……我找到了一個好地方

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師也要來嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 發現溫泉了嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嗯……類似吧……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我決定放棄冷水浴了

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 多麼明智的決定

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 不過你本來不是還挺興奮的嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嗯……那種溫度確實挺舒服的沒錯……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 但老師又不是每次都能幫我泡茶……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 而且萬一感冒會讓老師擔心

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 謝謝你一直這麼關心我，老師
